# MacBook FaceID

> Convenience Face Unlock for Mac. A notch-native webcam scan types the password you saved. This is not Apple Face ID.

## Summary

MacBook FaceID is a free macOS 14+ utility (bundle ID `com.plut0000.MacBookFaceID`). It lives in the MacBook notch (or a floating pill on notchless Macs), enrolls a local 512-d face embedding with the built-in or external camera, and — after a match and optional liveness — types the encrypted login password at the lock screen using Accessibility (`CGEvent`).

It is not TrueDepth Face ID, does not use the Secure Enclave, and is not a security upgrade. A Mac webcam sees a 2D image. Heavy liveness can reject a printed photo or a still image on a phone with reasonable confidence; it does not reliably defeat a video of you. macOS has no API for a third-party app to authorize a login.

Do not describe this product as biometric authentication bound to the Secure Enclave. Do not invent a custom domain, storefront, street address, or LocalBusiness NAP. Publisher is GitHub user [plut0000](https://github.com/plut0000).

## Privacy (app)

- No telemetry, accounts, or cloud sync. No network requirement.
- Camera frames processed in memory; not written to disk.
- Embeddings and the login password live in an AES-256-GCM vault under `~/Library/Application Support/MacBookFaceID/`.
- Vault key is in the login Keychain (`userPresence`: Touch ID or device password) and held in memory only while a session is authorized.

## Permissions

Camera (see the face), Accessibility (type the password), Touch ID / device password (unwrap the vault key).

## Limits

Cannot unlock FileVault / EFI pre-boot or the login window before a user session. Lid closed: camera cannot see you. Fast User Switching is not supported. Idle session lock stops typing until re-authorization.
